# Canvas formats and outputs

The formats a canvas page is drawn in and the output profiles of its images and print files. No door renders or prints a canvas for an agent.

[`format.create`](#formatcreate) · [`format.update`](#formatupdate) · [`format.remove`](#formatremove) · [`outputProfile.create`](#outputprofilecreate) · [`outputProfile.update`](#outputprofileupdate) · [`outputProfile.remove`](#outputprofileremove) · [`surface.set`](#surfaceset) · [`output.check`](#outputcheck)

## format.create

Add a format to the site: a box a canvas page is drawn in, in one unit, with optional margins, safe insets, bleed and its own output profile. A canvas lists the formats it is drawn in with surface.set. Refused: `format.exists` (the key is taken: format.update changes it), `format.profile` (its profile is not one of the site's: outputProfile.create adds it).

- **op**; class `design` (Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string (min 1, max 64) | yes | The format's key: lower-case letters, digits, - and _ (a canvas's surface and its fmt: scopes name it). |
| `format` | object | yes | The format whole: its label, width and height in its unit (px, mm, pt or in), and optional margins, safe insets, bleed and own output profile. |
| `format` › `label` | string (min 1, max 80) | yes |  |
| `format` › `width` | number ≤100000 | yes |  |
| `format` › `height` | number ≤100000 | yes |  |
| `format` › `unit` | "px" \| "mm" \| "pt" \| "in" | yes |  |
| `format` › `margins` | { top: number ≥0 ≤100000, right: number ≥0 ≤100000, bottom: number ≥0 ≤100000, left: number ≥0 ≤100000 } |  |  |
| `format` › `safe` | { top: number ≥0 ≤100000, right: number ≥0 ≤100000, bottom: number ≥0 ≤100000, left: number ≥0 ≤100000 } |  |  |
| `format` › `bleed` | number ≤100000 |  |  |
| `format` › `profile` | string (min 1, max 64) |  |  |

Example inputs:

```json
{"key":"manifesto-a3","format":{"label":"Manifesto A3","width":297,"height":420,"unit":"mm","bleed":3,"profile":"stampa"}}
```
```json
{"key":"storia","format":{"label":"Storia Instagram","width":1080,"height":1920,"unit":"px"}}
```

Example input:

## format.remove

Remove a format of the site. Refused: `format.inUse` (a canvas lists it, or a component's style has a fmt: scope for it: the refusal names them), `format.unknown` (no such format).

- **op**; class `design` (Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string (min 1, max 64) | yes | The key of the site's format or output profile. |

Example input:

```json
{"key":"storia"}
```

## outputProfile.create

Add an output profile to the site: how an image or a print output of a canvas is made. An image profile gives the file type and its scale or ppi; a print profile is PDF/X-4, with its printing condition and what a colour without an ink does (`refuse` or `convert`). Refused: `outputProfile.exists` (the key is taken: outputProfile.update changes it).

- **op**; class `design` (Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | string (min 1, max 64) | yes | The profile's key: lower-case letters, digits, - and _ (a format and a canvas's outputs name it). |
| `profile` | { medium: "image", type: "png" \| "jpeg" \| "webp", scale?: number ≤8, ppi?: number ≤2400, quality?: integer ≥1 ≤100 } \| { medium: "print", standard: "PDF/X-4", intent: { identifier: string (min 1, max 200), condition: string (min 1, max 500), registry: string (max 500), info: string (min 1, max 500), icc: string }, unma… (the whole schema: discover_operations with names) | yes | The profile whole: medium image (type png, jpeg or webp, a scale or a ppi, a quality for a lossy type) or medium print (PDF/X-4: its printing condition, what a colour without ink does, ink limit, image ppi, marks). |

Example inputs:

```json
{"key":"png-2x","profile":{"medium":"image","type":"png","scale":2}}
```
```json
{"key":"stampa","profile":{"medium":"print","standard":"PDF/X-4","unmapped":"convert","images":{"maxPpi":300,"minPpi":200},"intent":{"identifier":"FOGRA51","condition":"Offset su carta patinata, PSO Coated v3","registry":"https://www.color.org","info":"PSO Coated v3 (FOGRA51)","icc":"e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855"}}}
```

## surface.set

Set a canvas page's surface whole: the formats it is drawn in, its master format and the outputs built when the site is published. The master is the format its base styles are written for; the others override them in fmt:<key> scopes. Each output is a format and an output profile. Refused: `surface.canvas` (the page is not a canvas), `surface.formats` (a format or profile the site does not have), `scope.format` (a format dropped while the canvas still styles it), `unknown_page`. Findings: `output.ink`, a warning for each colour it paints with no print ink when one of its outputs prints.

- **op**; class `design` (Administrator); dry_run_ops judges it; one undo in History takes it back.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | The canvas page's id (site_context lists the pages). |
| `surface` | object | yes | The surface whole: formats (keys of the site's formats), master (one of them) and outputs ({ format, profile } pairs, built at publish). |
| `surface` › `formats` | string (min 1, max 64)[] (≤12) | yes |  |
| `surface` › `master` | string (min 1, max 64) | yes |  |
| `surface` › `outputs` | { format: string (min 1, max 64), profile: string (min 1, max 64) }[] (≤48) |  |  |

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"c4a1e7d2-5b3f-4e8a-9d06-7f2b1c3e5a90","surface":{"formats":["manifesto-a3","storia"],"master":"manifesto-a3","outputs":[{"format":"manifesto-a3","profile":"stampa"},{"format":"storia","profile":"png-2x"}]}}
```

## output.check

Read the print findings of a canvas: each colour it paints that has no ink in a print profile of its outputs. `output.ink` is an error where the profile refuses such a colour (that print is not made) and a warning where it converts it. `format` narrows it to one of the canvas's formats; `profile` asks about a profile of the site the canvas does not build yet. A read: it changes nothing. Refused: `output.notCanvas`, `output.format` (the canvas is not drawn in that format), `outputProfile.unknown`, `unknown_page`. Output: { findings }.

- **read op**; class `content` (Content author, Designer, Administrator); cannot be dry-run; not undoable.

| Input | Type | Required | Says |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | uuid | yes | The canvas page's id. |
| `format` | string (min 1, max 64) |  | Only this one of the canvas's formats; absent: all of them. |
| `profile` | string (min 1, max 64) |  | Judge with this profile of the site on each format, even one the canvas does not build yet; absent: the outputs it builds. |

Example inputs:

```json
{"pageId":"c4a1e7d2-5b3f-4e8a-9d06-7f2b1c3e5a90","format":"manifesto-a3"}
```
```json
{"pageId":"c4a1e7d2-5b3f-4e8a-9d06-7f2b1c3e5a90","profile":"stampa"}
```
